rules: archival changes eligibility/presentation only and never deletes policy/classification/report history

guards: new Customer incompatible with current CPL Contract Customer

rules: every change appends immutable classification event
customer invalidation never selects a replacement
live SLA is derived from current classification/current policy and not persisted as lifecycle authority

guards: stable accepted-state Snapshot still owns source rows
candidate identity bound to exact sealed snapshot
durable job at safe cancellation boundary

rules: completed state and completed child evidence are immutable
failed/cancelled retain bounded attempt/audit metadata but no full staged population
external temp-file cleanup never changes database authority

projection_rules: Individual SLA and canonical cohort state are pure as-of projections, not lifecycle state machines.
A new current policy revision changes subsequent live projections without rewriting prior SR classification events or completed reports.
Objective scheduling timezone cannot transition or reinterpret any SLA/report state; contractual cohort chronology is America/Guayaquil.
